Codman Square is a vibrant part of Dorchester, with several organizations actively working to improve the community. The Codman Square Neighborhood Development Corporation (CSNDC) is a key player, focusing on housing and economic development. They've reported significant progress on affordable housing projects, like the Four Corners Plaza near Washington and Bowdoin Streets, which is nearing completion with a ribbon-cutting event planned for this summer. The Spenser Street site, part of the Talbot Commons II project, is also on track.

CSNDC also works to support local businesses. They recently received findings from a study by UMass Boston students on business displacement in Codman Square, which they'll use to advocate for businesses in the area.

Beyond development, Codman Square is also known for its community initiatives. The Codman Square Neighborhood Council has been involved in fighting for food justice and has celebrated the return of the Codman Square Farmers Market, which started on Saturdays. Additionally, the Codman Square Health Center has expanded its reach, now welcoming new patients at its Randolph location inside Randolph High School.
